independence_unit: Analytical, normative, or third-party-oracle cases; expected values are not copied from insertion_loss_tool output.

cases.purpose: Prevent a packaged self-test from accepting a non-passive final file.
cases.oracle: Direct NumPy singular-value decomposition without calling production diagnostics.
cases.expected: maximum singular value 1.04 at 1 GHz; rejection

cases.purpose: Bind minimum insertion loss to the reflection power budget of the generated reciprocal S2P model.
Accept the official Touchstone 2.1 example in which option fields appear in a different legal order.
cases.provenance: IBIS Open Forum, Touchstone File Format Specification Version 2.1, physical PDF pages 7-9, especially option-line rules and example '# S R 100 GHz RI'.

cases.purpose: Prevent Sij transposition and over-wide physical lines in common multi-port writer output.
cases.provenance: IBIS Touchstone 2.1 physical PDF pages 5 and 15-19; independently parsed by scikit-rf 1.7.0.
cases.expected: scikit-rf Network.s equals the original output,input matrix exactly within 1e-15; physical continuation lines contain at most four complex pairs

cases.purpose: Make the 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 port UI choices generate deterministic, passive networks without inventing a three-port splitter or circulator topology.
cases.provenance: User-approved common port set on 2026-08-30; adjacent reciprocal lane policy is an explicit tool contract.
cases.oracle: Independent scikit-rf 1.7.0 readback plus hand calculations: |Sii|=10^(-20/20), adjacent-lane |Sij|=10^(-IL/20), all other off-diagonals=10^(-80/20), reciprocity exact within serialization tolerance, and sigma_max<=1+1e-9.
cases.expected: All five files reopen with the requested matrix size and five frequencies; the three-port default leaves port 3 at the reflection/crosstalk floor until explicit through paths are supplied.

cases.purpose: Prevent ambiguous or structurally incomplete Touchstone 2.x files from being accepted.
cases.provenance: IBIS Touchstone 2.1 physical PDF pages 5-10, required keyword and ordering rules.
cases.expected: all variants rejected before an ambiguous matrix can be returned

cases.purpose: Prevent feasible default Modify targets from being rejected because an unconstrained Gaussian RBF creates gain between control points.
cases.provenance: User-reported escaped defect reproduced through InsertionLossWebApi defaults on 2026-09-02.
cases.independent_oracle: Direct NumPy SVD of the reread Touchstone output plus exact dB evaluation at inserted target frequencies.
cases.pre_fix_observation: The RBF correction reached -1.1487422408 dB, produced -0.2640000308 dB insertion loss near 1.1597125 GHz, and failed with sigma_max 1.0356997021.
cases.expected: public Modify path succeeds; both targets are exact within 1e-6 dB; every sampled sigma_max is at most 1+1e-9

cases.purpose: Keep feasible target samples exact while contracting only an intervening passivity overshoot.
cases.oracle: The spectral-norm unit ball is convex; bisection on the line from the passive original matrix to the candidate must retain the largest feasible fraction. NumPy SVD independently checks every output sample.
cases.expected: 1 dB targets remain exact, S11/S22 remain unchanged, and the 3 GHz sample is contracted to sigma_max<=1

cases.purpose: Distinguish a non-passive source file from a target that is itself infeasible.
cases.oracle: Closed-form singular values of constant symmetric 2x2 matrices.
cases.expected: source defect reports 'Input ... not passive'; feasible source with impossible target reports 'Requested target ... passivity'

cases.purpose: Exercise generation, modification, serialization, and invalid passivity handling across varied sweeps.
cases.expected: 325 cases complete; zero nominal passivity failures; deliberate zero-loss-with-reflection case is rejected
